physical_warnings.interpretation: source-data anomaly requires quarantine before any population mixture
spherical-average density integration is not ready to define returned mass without a source-specific correction or authoritative scalar

physical_review_policy.quarantine_rule: models at or above the gross threshold cannot enter a production mixture without source resolution

data_semantics.integrated_abundance_decay_horizon: stable elements/isotopes after about 2 Gyr; radioactive isotopes at end of simulation
data_semantics.hydro_profile: spherical-average density and isotope mass fractions
data_semantics.hydrogen_profile_mapping: free-proton column p is explicitly mapped to H; no implicit missing-element zero
data_semantics.event_energy: not supplied as a scalar event field; derive only under an approved profile convention
data_semantics.event_momentum: signed vector is not determined by spherical-average files

conversion_blockers: select a concrete HESMA model or approved population mixture
pin decay horizon and isotope-to-11-element conversion, including the explicit p-to-H mapping
derive and validate returned mass and kinetic energy from a documented profile convention or an authoritative scalar source
obtain a signed momentum convention/source; spherical average alone is insufficient
bind population weighting, approval id, and deterministic converted-asset checksum
interpretation: HESMA supplies a public, checksum-bound composition/profile candidate with all 11 integrated project elements, but this report does not approve event conversion or runtime activation.
